svg.text: M1’s single-row pass gates every speculation milestone
M0 · Baselines
Streaming-bandwidth microbenchmark, public SGLang recipe and BF16 quality reference on this box
Every target below is restated against the measured bus
Gate: measured GB/s recorded; all targets restated
M1 · Single-row fused path
NVFP4 blob in tile order, five kernels per layer, FP8 KV, one CUDA graph, memory plan
Quality gate on the quantized model; greedy output matches the reference
Gate: 90% of the measured bus at 1 row; host under 1 ms
M2 · Exact speculation
Row buckets 8, 16 and 32, DFlash2 as shipped, DeltaNet replay, prompt-lookup splice
Exactness suite green for every bucket
Gate: greedy output identical; prose at 55 tokens/s or more
M3 · Fast speculation
NVFP4 drafter, 32k-token draft head, drafter inside the step graph, tree of 16, block-16 trial
Acceptance measured per workload against the shipped drafter
Gate: prose 60, code 90, edits 150 tokens/s or more
M4 · Product
Sessions with prefix check and background re-prefill, chunked prefill, images, OpenAI API, tool calls
16-task speed suite run against the public recipe on the same box
Gate: follow-up first token 80 ms or less; suite published
M5 · Hardening
10-minute thermal runs, 262k context, 4-bit KV option, telemetry, small-batch mode for 2–4 agents
Release manifest with precision map, template hash and Nsight traces
Gate: all three validation gates green; release
